newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae group nominates 13 for board.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae group nominates 13 for board.

text.p: The Committee to Restore Value, a shareholder group at Student Loan Marketing Association (Salllie Mae) which opposes its management, Thursday announced a slate of 13 nominees for the board of directors of a proposed new holding company.

The CRV's nominees include Edward Fox, who was president and chief executive of Sallie Mae from 1973 to 1990. Fox is currently dean of the Amos Tuck School of Buiness at Dartmouth College. The CRV said Fox has agreed to serve as chairman of the reorganized company if elected.
The CRV nominees include eight people who are presently Sallie Mae directors.
The CRV reaffirmed its intention to hold a special meeting May 9.
